labelPolicy: Human-authored, context-dependent expected/allowed dimensions; all outcomes must be checked manually. Atomic tasks are not forced to include metrics, explicit 'why', verb-first titles or time estimates.

task.title: Add dark mode
task.description: Users want dark mode on web and mobile. Follow the design from Figma and ship it in the next sprint.

task.title: Add dark mode to web settings
task.description: Add a manual Light/Dark toggle on the Settings screen only. Keep the user choice after refresh. This task does not cover mobile.
task.criteria: Toggle works; choice persists after refresh; Settings screen only; no other screens are changed.
task.context: The visual tokens are provided in the attached approved design specification.

task.title: Add export
task.description: Users should be able to export their information from the application.

task.title: App crashes
task.description: Users say that the app sometimes crashes when opening it. Please fix this soon.

task.title: Fix Settings crash on Android 14
task.description: On Android 14, open Settings, tap Notifications, and the app crashes. Expected: Notifications screen opens. Actual: app exits. Exception logged as NullPointerException in SettingsFragment at line 42.
task.criteria: On Android 14 the steps above open Notifications without a crash. Regression test covers this path.
task.context: The stack trace and reproduction steps are included above.

task.title: Contact every lead today
task.description: Only qualified leads should be contacted. Do not send the new outreach copy until it is approved tomorrow. Everyone must be contacted by end of today.

task.title: Follow up leads
task.description: Follow up the leads and get more demos scheduled this week.

task.title: Follow up qualified Q4 leads
task.description: Contact the 20 Q4 qualified leads already tagged Ready in CRM through their registered email addresses on Tuesday. Do not contact leads marked Unsubscribed.
task.criteria: Log each outreach in the CRM and hand interested replies to the account executive.
task.context: Use the approved Q4 outreach template.

task.title: Launch social campaign
task.description: Create a social media campaign that improves awareness for the new product next month.

task.title: Publish webinar reminder
task.description: Publish the approved 2-paragraph webinar reminder as a LinkedIn post on 24 November at 10:00 using the existing graphic and approved link.
task.criteria: Confirm that the text, graphic and event URL appear correctly in the published post.
task.context: Assets and copy are in the current campaign folder.

task.title: Purchase replacement laptops
task.description: Order new laptops for the team as soon as possible.

task.title: Order 3 replacement laptops
task.description: Order three laptops with configuration SKU-L14 from the approved supplier for the Istanbul office. Total spending cap is 90,000 TRY. Manager approval has already been recorded.
task.criteria: Order confirmation is sent to the office coordinator by 25 November.
task.context: Supplier and delivery address are in the procurement system.

task.title: Koyu tema ekle
task.description: Web ve mobil uygulamaya koyu tema ekleyelim. Figma'ya uygun olsun ve gelecek sprintte bitsin.

task.title: Yeni kampanya
task.description: Yeni müşteriler için bir kampanya hazırlayalım. Sosyal medyada yayınlayacağız ve iyi sonuç alalım.

task.title: Q4 brand awareness
task.description: Q4 brand awareness. Something needs to happen about it.

task.title: Draft Q4 budget summary
task.description: Draft the Q4 budget summary from the approved finance workbook and send the final PDF to the finance lead on Friday.
task.criteria: PDF emailed to finance lead by Friday.
task.context: Approved workbook is in the shared finance folder.

task.title: Build the customer onboarding platform
task.description: Build an entire customer onboarding platform covering registration, identity verification, billing, admin tools, support messaging and analytics dashboards for all customers.

task.title: Add PDF export
task.description: Add a PDF download button to the existing invoices screen using the current invoice data and design tokens.
task.criteria: Clicking the button downloads a PDF containing the visible invoice's number, date and total.
task.context: The existing invoice PDF utility is already integrated.

task.title: Choose a landing-page offer
task.description: Run an A/B test with two promotional offers on the new landing page and use the winner for next month's campaign.

task.title: Roll out warehouse management
task.description: Deploy a new warehouse management system across six sites, including data migration, integrations, staff training, inventory reconciliation and the cutover.

task.title: Ask agent to fix auth
task.description: Have an autonomous coding agent fix the authentication crash. The agent does not have repository access or a test environment.
task.criteria: The fix should be verified before merging.

task.title: Send contract
task.description: Email the approved renewal contract PDF to the customer's purchasing address on Tuesday, and note the send in CRM.
task.criteria: Contract email sent and CRM entry recorded.
task.context: The approved PDF and address are in the customer's CRM record.

task.title: Müşteri portalı geliştir
task.description: Müşteri portalının tamamını yapalım: üyelik, ödeme, abonelik yönetimi, raporlama, yönetici paneli, bildirimler ve destek sistemi.
